text:
maria: Cutting RC candidate rc-2026-03-20b now. Plan: staging->prod handshake at 09:30 PT, KV warm on dedicated pools, staged traffic swap (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Pin artifact sha: abc123def. Ops/QA please ACK.

devon: Ack. Running kv-warm and healthchecks now. Command I'm using: `./tools/kv_warm --pool=dedicated --parallel=4`

ops_liz: On it — scheduling the traffic shim and prepopulating fallback route. Sheriffs on standby. I'll post when warm completes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rc-originate request received for rc-2026-03-20b. Orchestration starting. Canary pause window: 10m after canary.

maria: Reminder: rollback signal is `rollback/rc-2026-03-20b` in the ops-runbook. Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 250ms or errors > 1% in first 10m.

qa_jun: Quick smoke in staging looked good. Found minor retriever timeout; applied config tweak `retriever.timeout=2s` and re-ran smoke. Passing now.

devon: KV-warm output shows ~95% hit rate after warming. Quick check: `tail -n50 /var/log/kv_warm.log | grep warmed` shows expected nodes.

ops_liz: :thumbsup: Starting staged 5% traffic shift to rc-2026-03-20b in us-east-1.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled traffic shift started. Canary target 5% for 10m. Notifying oncall.

ryan_oncall: Oncall here. Watching SLOs, traces, and error rates. If anything spikes I'll cut traffic back to 0% and mark for rollback.

maria: If canary looks good at 10m we'll move to 25% then to 100% over 30m. Release notes draft: `rc-2026-03-20b: kv warm, retriever timeout fix, minor schema bump.` Keep it terse.

sheriff_tom: I'll be ready to run the rollback command if needed: `opsctl rollout revert --pin=prev-stable --reason="canary-failed"`.

qa_jun: Canary smoke passed. No user-facing errors in trace. Approving promo.

devon: 25% -> 60% traffic shift started. Observability dashboards look stable so far.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic shift to 60% complete. No alerts triggered.

ryan_oncall: :white_check_mark: No SLO violations. Approving final cut window. Promo to 100% scheduled in 10m.

ops_liz: Artifact pinned in registry: `registry.redwood/rc-2026-03-20b@sha256:abc123def`. KV caches will continue warm post-promo.

maria: Final: promote to prod now. Everyone standby for 30m post-cut and watch the rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promotion complete. All routes updated. Post-cut hooks triggered: kv cache confirm, telemetry warm, smoke tests.

devon: Post-cut KV hit rate steady at ~93%. No increase in error budget seen in the last 15m.

qa_jun: Running quick E2E on payments/v1 — all green.

ryan_oncall: Closing thread — no regressions observed. Great coordination, team! :tada:
